title: 第二十九章 拍卖会前夕
novel_title: 凡人修仙：谁说修仙必须灵力
content_zh:
炼器铺内，侯紫站在崔成敏旁边，说“老崔，别说什么辅佐的话，在一起互相帮忙就行，我就是一混混，混过日子的。”

    “不，你不是普通人，我认定你了，名份先定，以后才不会乱。”崔成敏很肯定的说。

    侯紫挠挠头发，说“既然这样，好吧，我当竭尽所能。你现在先帮我看样东西。”说着，侯紫从靴筒里拿出那把小剑，递给崔成敏。

    崔成敏接过手，抚摸了下，又摘下眼镜详细观看这把侯紫视若珍宝的宝贝。

    一会，崔成敏叹了口气，对侯紫说：“这就是一把炼气期常用的飞剑，大部分宗门弟子都有一把。当然对于散修来说，还是很珍贵的。毕竟炼器材料不是那么容易得到的。”

    侯紫吸了口气，幸亏当时杀陆继的时候，是白玉角蜥干的最后一下，要是照原计划用这把小剑杀，大概率杀不动陆继。突然有点想那大家伙了，大家伙莫非是筑基期？不知道现在怎么样了。

    “这样吧，你把小剑给我，我加些材料重新炼制，提高它的等级，也把宗门痕迹消除掉。”崔成敏顿了下，又开口说道：“你那个筑基修士的储物袋我可以解，但得做好万全的准备，不然只能毁了这袋子，一般都有特殊标记，你带着这袋子，就像带着颗随时引爆的火药。三天后，五界商会的孤狼有一场散修之家拍卖会，有我们需要的材料，我们争取弄来，据说还有筑基丹压轴拍卖，这整个坊市除了城主是筑基中期，其他人都卡在炼气后期了，到时候那可真是风云际会了。”

    侯紫直接把小剑塞给崔成敏，然后说，“你做主就好，我现在觉得武器对我暂时没用，要么弄掉宗门标记，给黑猫防身也行。”

    这时，沈君壁插了句嘴，“老崔，拍卖会都是什么情况呀？韩家也会参加吗？”

    “会啊，这是散修之家的盛会，一年才有一次，各方势力肯定都参加，经常也是各方角力的盛会的。我们要去参加也要做好准备的。比如准备灵石，或者把不用的宝贝也可以拿去拍卖的。”崔成敏说道。

    侯紫和沈君壁对视一眼，尴尬一笑，呵呵，哪还有灵石！

    贪狼毕景元正在训话他的队员，“三天后的拍卖会，兄弟们都提起精神，确保安全，孤狼这次可舍得下本，直接给了我们一千灵石做安保费用，比以往可翻了一倍。最近进出坊市的散修要多加盘查。”

    “是。”一众队员整齐的应了一声。
content_en:
In the weapon refining shop, Hou Zi stood next to Cui Chengmin and said, "Old Cui, don't say anything about assisting, just help each other together. I just hang out and get by."

"No, you are not an ordinary person. I have identified you. The name should be determined first so that there will be no chaos in the future." Cui Chengmin said firmly.

Hou Zi scratched her hair and said, "In this case, okay, I will do my best. You can help me look at something now." After saying that, Hou Zi took out the small sword from the boot and handed it to Cui Chengmin.

Cui Chengmin took the hand, stroked it, and then took off his glasses to look at the treasure that Hou Zi regarded as a treasure.

After a while, Cui Chengmin sighed and said to Hou Zi: "This is a flying sword commonly used during the Qi refining period. Most disciples of the sect have one. Of course, it is still very precious to casual cultivators. After all, the materials for refining weapons are not so easy to obtain."

Hou Zi took a breath. Fortunately, when he killed Lu Ji, it was the white jade horned lizard that did the last blow. If he had used this small sword to kill him as planned, he would probably not be able to kill Lu Ji.Suddenly I missed that big guy. Could it be that the big guy is in the foundation building stage?I don’t know what’s going on now.

"Let's do this, give me the small sword, and I will add some materials to refining it, improve its level, and eliminate the traces of the sect." Cui Chengmin paused for a moment, and then said: "I can unpack your foundation-building monk's storage bag, but you must be fully prepared, otherwise you will have to destroy the bag. It usually has special markings. You take this bag with you., It’s like carrying a gunpowder that can be detonated at any time.Three days later, the Lone Wolf of the Five Realms Chamber of Commerce will hold an auction at the house of casual cultivators. There will be materials we need. We will try to get them. It is said that there will also be a final auction of foundation building pills. Except for the city lord, who is in the middle stage of foundation building, everyone else is stuck in the late stage of Qi refining.It will be a great event then. "

Hou Zi directly handed the small sword to Cui Chengmin, and then said, "You can make the decision. I feel that the weapon is useless to me for the time being. Or I can remove the sect mark and use it to defend myself for the black cat."

At this time, Shen Junbi interrupted, "Old Cui, what's going on at the auction? Will the Han family also participate?"

"Yes, this is a grand event for the house of casual cultivators. It only happens once a year. All forces must participate, and it is often a grand event where all parties compete. We must be prepared to participate. For example, prepare spiritual stones, or auction unused treasures." Cui Chengmin said.

Hou Zi and Shen Junbi looked at each other and smiled awkwardly, haha, where is the spirit stone!

Greedy Wolf Bi Jingyuan is lecturing his team members, "For the auction three days later, brothers must be alert and ensure safety. Lone Wolf is willing to spend money this time and directly gave us a thousand spirit stones for security expenses, which is double the previous amount. Rogue cultivators entering and leaving the market recently need to be more interrogated."

"Yes." All the team members responded in unison.
title_en: Chapter 29 The Eve of the Auction
